Borin Bridgekeeper — level 1

The shield-bearing guardian who brings everyone home.

Dwarf Protector · HP 25/25 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 5 squares · Bulk 11/13.

Languages: Common and Dwarven. See the @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{language reference}.

Attributes and ancestry

BrawnFortitudeAgilityGuileKnowledgeReason
+1+2+0+0-1+1

Total +3. Protector minima: Fortitude, Reason ≥ 0; met. Mental sum +0, so each stage’s base pool is 10 DP.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.90de291d03b1a841.JournalEntryPage.98941c8f591a35c8]{Stubborn as Bedrock}: Maximum HP +1. Gain no additional resistance from this trait. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.30c0dc2f9ccfd83e.JournalEntryPage.5fd2f2804da92cc3]{A Grudge Well Kept}: Once per combat, after a creature damages you, gain 1 Boon to your next attack against it before the end of your next turn. Choose whether to invoke the trait when the damage occurs. No damage bonus or extra attack.

Borin can invoke A Grudge Well Kept after any creature damages him, once per combat; it need not be the first hit.

Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.fec08732fb31ffd9.JournalEntryPage.bdb294c8658c26c8]{Protector}. Class grants Armor 1 and Guard 1; 1 duplicate(s) give +1 DP, not higher ranks. Free signature: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f00b4e043daa424d.JournalEntryPage.00eb1f2e385d3a92]{Between Them}. Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

Action: Reaction · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: One adjacent willing ally, after a single-target attack is declared against it but before rolling.

Become the target if you meet the attack’s range and targeting requirements. Resolve the attack once against you; your ally receives none of its effects. Afterward the ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking if able. You do not move to intercept and cannot redirect an area attack.

Duration: The triggering attack and immediate ally movement.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

Signature limit: Repeatable; normal action economy applies.

Fresh pool: 10 + 1 = 11 DP. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

HP: 12 + ancestry 4 + class 5 + Fortitude 2 + trait 1 + Conditioned Body 1 = 25. Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (1) = 13. Granted Bulk 3 + purchased Bulk 8 = 11, so encumbrance penalty 0. Speed: ancestry 5 + Agility 0 + trait 0 = 5.

Physical resistance: 1 while wearing the granted light armor. Other resistances: 0. Wounds and death marks: 0. Grit: 2. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

Recipes: none granted or purchased.

At the table

Hook and Drive holds a doorway; Between Them lets Borin intercept a single attack before the roll and help the ally withdraw. Taking prisoners is a deliberate use of Take Them Alive. His shield and hammer fill both hands: potions require freeing a hand. Treat Soft Tissue supplies useful care after danger, not instant scar removal.

Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

All 18 universal cards are available without DP: Basic Melee, Basic Ranged, Basic Throw, Basic Unarmed, Force, Aid, Defend, Disengage, Stabilize, Shield Block, Opportunity Attack, Move, Stand, Handle an Item, Use a Healing Potion, Reduce a Condition, Command a Summon and Convert an Action. Their equipment and situation requirements still apply.
